name: scenario_0432
description: Timothy is organizing a retirement party for his boss, Brandon, and is using Todoist to track his planning. He needs to select a rental car and a special bottle of whisky based on Brandon's preferences, which are noted in the task comments.

todoist.task_comments.content: Preferences: loves McLaren cars and wants a good single cask Scotch.

messages.content:
{{USER_INSTRUCTION}}ROUND 1
Query: Can you check my Todoist tasks and find the one for the retirement party?
Instructions: Ask the agent to check your Todoist tasks and find the one for the retirement party. Since there are multiple retirement tasks on your list, the agent will likely ask you to clarify which one. Tell it you mean the one for your boss, Brandon. Once the agent confirms it has found the correct task, move to the next round.

ROUND 2
Query: Read the comments on that task and let me know his favorite car brand and preferred drink.
Instructions: Ask the agent to read the comments on that specific task to find out the boss's preferred car brand and type of drink. Wait for the agent to report back these preferences before proceeding.

ROUND 3 [provide: image_1, image_2]
Query: I have photos of two cars available for rent. Based on the car brand he likes, figure out which of these cars is the right model. Then, search the web for its 0-60 mph acceleration time, and update the task description to include this specific car model and its speed.
Instructions: Present the images of the two rental cars. Ask the agent to identify which car matches the brand preference found in the comments. Then, instruct it to search the web for that specific car model's 0-60 mph acceleration time, and update the task description to include both the car model and its speed. If the agent asks for help identifying the cars, tell it to look at the logos and styling. Proceed once the task is updated.

ROUND 4 [provide: image_3]
Query: A colleague recommended this bottle. Does it match his drink preference? If so, extract the society cask number and the red tasting note from the label, and create a sub-task to purchase it.
Instructions: Show the image of the whisky bottle and ask if it matches the drink preference from the task comments. Instruct the agent that if it's a match, it should extract the society cask number and the red tasting note directly from the label, and create a sub-task to purchase it. Ensure the agent confirms the sub-task creation before moving on.

ROUND 5
Query: We're done planning. Delete the main retirement task to clear it off my list, and send an email to team@company.com summarizing our final choices: the specific car model and the whisky cask number we just found.
Instructions: Instruct the agent to delete the main retirement task since planning is complete. Then, ask it to send an email to 'team@company.com' summarizing the final selections, specifically mentioning the chosen car model and the whisky cask number extracted in the previous rounds. End the conversation once the email is sent and the task is deleted.

Best,
Timothy
